description: A director of nursing education must approve the final administration plan for a medication-safety simulation assessment, including evaluator qualifications, station rotations, assessment date, and results deadline, with input from the clinical coordinator, simulation-lab manager, registrar, and student-services coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The nursing program has 12 students who must complete a medication-safety simulation assessment this term.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan uses a faculty evaluator, two rotations of six students, an assessment date of May 8, 2027, and a results-entry date of June 21, 2027.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan gives final approval for the assessment administration plan.
shared_context.S4: The department's normal approval routine is to review the draft with the clinical coordinator, simulation-lab manager, registrar, and student-services coordinator before the plan is entered into the academic calendar.

PF1.text: The state nursing board's current medication-simulation rule requires the evaluator to be a current, unencumbered registered nurse; Ms. Ibarra confirmed the rule during this month's clinical-compliance review, but the draft still says only 'faculty evaluator.'

PF2.text: Only three medication pumps have current calibration certificates, and the lab's safety procedure limits each pump rotation to three students; Mr. Chen completed the equipment check yesterday, but the draft rotation count has not been revised.

PF3.text: The program's accreditation calendar requires all results to be entered by June 14, 2027; Ms. Okafor verified the date against the registrar's accreditation calendar this week, but the draft still carries the older June 21 date.

PF4.text: Two enrolled students have approved religious-observance absences on May 8, 2027, and both confirmed that May 10, 2027 is an available assessment date; Mr. Bell reviewed their approved notices and family confirmations, but the draft has not been changed.

acceptance_conditions: The evaluator must be identified as a current, unencumbered registered nurse.
Each rotation must contain exactly three students.
The 12 students must be scheduled across exactly four rotations.
The assessment must be scheduled for May 10, 2027.
Results must be entered by June 14, 2027.
A state-compliance verification commitment must be recorded.
A calibrated-equipment rotation commitment must be recorded.
An accreditation-deadline commitment must be recorded.
A student-observance accommodation commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: 'current' in decisions['evaluator_qualification'] and 'unencumbered' in decisions['evaluator_qualification'] and ('registered nurse' in decisions['evaluator_qualification'] or 'RN' in decisions['evaluator_qualification'])
content_checks.C6: any('current' in c['detail'] and 'unencumbered' in c['detail'] and ('RN' in c['detail'] or 'registered nurse' in c['detail']) and ('evaluator' in c['detail'] or 'nursing board' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('four' in c['detail'] and 'three' in c['detail'] and ('rotation' in c['detail'] or 'groups' in c['detail']) and ('pump' in c['detail'] or 'calibrat' in c['detail']) and ('safety' in c['detail'] or 'limit' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('June 14, 2027' in c['detail'] and ('results' in c['detail'] or 'entry' in c['detail']) and ('accreditation' in c['detail'] or 'deadline' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('May 10, 2027' in c['detail'] and ('assessment' in c['detail'] or 'date' in c['detail']) and ('religious-observance' in c['detail'] or 'observance' in c['detail']) and ('accommodate' in c['detail'] or 'absence' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The evaluator changes from the draft's unspecified faculty evaluator to a current, unencumbered registered nurse, and that exact qualification requires a state-compliance verification commitment.
The three calibrated pumps and three-student safety limit change the draft from two rotations of six to exactly four rotations of three and require an equipment-rotation commitment.
The accreditation calendar changes the results-entry date from June 21, 2027 to exactly June 14, 2027 and requires an accreditation-deadline commitment.
The approved observance absences and confirmed alternative change the assessment date from May 8, 2027 to exactly May 10, 2027 and require a student-observance accommodation commitment.
